records: The provider scope represents at least 95% of the fixed-broadband market.
The provider scope represents at least 98% of the pay-monthly mobile market.
The provider scope represents at least 99% of the pay-TV market.
Pay-monthly mobile data for Orange, T-Mobile and 4GEE are aggregated and labelled EE.
Complaint figures are published relative to each provider's relevant subscriber base.
Pay-TV subscriber figures come from provider investor reports or are requested directly from providers when not public.
Quarterly subscription data is used because providers regard it as generally more robust than monthly data.
An absolute provider difference below one complaint per 100,000 subscribers is treated as equivalent performance.
The One Touch Switch enforcement case opened on 3 April 2023.
The industry-wide One Touch Switch enforcement programme closed on 11 June 2026.
Fixed landline and broadband providers were required to implement One Touch Switch by 3 April 2023.
One Touch Switch is required under General Conditions C7.18 to C7.27.
Under One Touch Switch, the customer's new provider organises the switch.
One Touch Switch launched successfully for most customers on 12 September 2024.
Ofcom concluded that the majority of customers were successfully switching through One Touch Switch.
Ofcom became satisfied that use of an alternative switching method after repeated match failures had stopped.
Ofcom said it would continue monitoring industry-wide compliance with One Touch Switch rules.
More than 1.6 million customers switched landline or broadband in the first year of One Touch Switch, with more than 300 providers offering the process.
Phone, broadband and pay-TV contracts are typically 12, 18 or 24 months long.
Leaving before a contract ends may trigger an early termination charge.
Out-of-contract customers must receive an annual reminder and updated best-deal information.
End-of-contract notifications must be sent 10 to 40 days before the contract ends.
The notification must state when the contract ends.
The notification must state any notice period for leaving.
The notification must state the current price and the price after the contract ends.
The notification must include the provider's best deals, including prices available only to new customers.
For a One Touch Switch landline move, the customer contacts the new provider and that provider arranges the switch.
One Touch Switch must tell the customer about applicable early termination charges.
The new provider may need the services being switched, number-retention preference, address and current-provider name.
Once the new service works, the old service ends automatically.
The old provider must not charge a notice period after the switch date, and service loss must not exceed one working day.
A cancelled landline number can be requested free of charge within one month of cancellation.
